# Variables

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from pihello.sources.catalog() and the demo data;
     do not edit by hand. Run `uv run python scripts/gen_docs.py` after changing a variable. -->

Templates read Pi-hole data through dotted **paths** such as `{queries.total}`.
The first part of a path is its *namespace*.
pihello only calls the API endpoints whose namespaces a template uses (in parallel),
so a short template is also a fast one.

- **`N`** stands for a list index:
  `{top_domains.0.domain}` is the first item, `{top_domains.-1.domain}` the last.
  Filters work on whole lists: `{history|pluck(total)|spark}`.
  See [Variable paths](templates.md#variable-paths).
- **Types**: `int`, `float`, `str`, `bool`, `list` (of objects), `list[str]`, `list[float]`,
  and `timestamp` (unix seconds; use the `ago` or `datetime` [filter](filters.md#time)).
- ***derived*** values are computed by pihello from the endpoint's data.
- **Example** values are pihello's demo data, as shown by `pihello vars --demo`.
  `pihello vars` shows your own Pi-hole's values;
  `pihello vars --all` also lists every list item,
  and any key Pi-hole sends that isn't documented here.
- A value that is unavailable (an older Pi-hole, a `null`, an empty list) renders as `?`,
  or fails with `--strict`.
  See [Missing values](templates.md#missing-values).

Every endpoint below exists in every Pi-hole v6 release.
A few *fields* were added later; their descriptions say so (e.g. "FTL v6.3+").
[Pi-hole compatibility](compatibility.md) records the exact differences per version.

## Namespaces

| Namespace | Endpoint (`GET /api/…`) | Description |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| [`queries`](#queries-clients-gravity), [`clients`](#queries-clients-gravity), [`gravity`](#queries-clients-gravity) | `stats/summary` | Query totals for the last 24 hours, client counts and gravity (block list) status |
| [`blocking`](#blocking-timer), [`timer`](#blocking-timer) | `dns/blocking` | Whether ad blocking is enabled, and the remaining time of a temporary toggle |
| [`recent_blocked`](#recent_blocked-recent_blocked_list), [`recent_blocked_list`](#recent_blocked-recent_blocked_list) | `stats/recent_blocked?count=10` | The most recently blocked domains |
| [`version`](#version-updates), [`updates`](#version-updates) | `info/version` | Installed and latest versions of Pi-hole Core, Web, FTL and the Docker image |
| [`system`](#system) | `info/system` | Host uptime, memory, processes and CPU load |
| [`host`](#host) | `info/host` | Host name, kernel and hardware model |
| [`sensors`](#sensors) | `info/sensors` | Temperature sensors |
| [`ftl`](#ftl) | `info/ftl` | FTL (Pi-hole's DNS engine) process, database counts and resolver metrics |
| [`database`](#database) | `info/database` | Long-term query database (pihole-FTL.db) file and contents |
| [`messages`](#messages) | `info/messages/count` | Number of Pi-hole diagnosis messages |
| [`top_domains`](#top_domains) | `stats/top_domains?count=10` | The 10 most queried permitted domains |
| [`top_blocked`](#top_blocked) | `stats/top_domains?blocked=true&count=10` | The 10 most blocked domains |
| [`top_clients`](#top_clients) | `stats/top_clients?count=10` | The 10 most active clients |
| [`top_blocked_clients`](#top_blocked_clients) | `stats/top_clients?blocked=true&count=10` | The 10 clients with the most blocked queries |
| [`upstreams`](#upstreams) | `stats/upstreams` | Upstream DNS servers and how often each was used |
| [`history`](#history) | `history` | Query activity over the last 24 hours in 10-minute buckets |
| [`network`](#network) | `network/gateway` | Default gateway, interface and the Pi-hole's own addresses |
| [`now`](#now-pihello-pihole), [`pihello`](#now-pihello-pihole), [`pihole`](#now-pihello-pihole) | — (built in) | The current time, pihello's version, the Pi-hole URL |

## `blocking`, `timer`

Whether ad blocking is enabled, and the remaining time of a temporary toggle.
From `GET /api/dns/blocking`.

| Path | Type | Description | Example |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `blocking` | `str` | Blocking state: "enabled", "disabled", "failed" or "unknown" | `"enabled"` |
| `timer` | `float` | Seconds until a temporary enable/disable is reverted; null without a timer | `null` |

## `recent_blocked`, `recent_blocked_list`

The most recently blocked domains.
From `GET /api/stats/recent_blocked?count=10`.

| Path | Type | Description | Example |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `recent_blocked` | `str` | The most recently blocked domain ("" if none yet) *(derived)* | `"googleads.g.doubleclick.net"` |
| `recent_blocked_list` | `list[str]` | The 10 most recent blocked queries' domains, newest first (a domain may repeat, e.g. A + AAAA) | `[10 items]` |

## `version`, `updates`

Installed and latest versions of Pi-hole Core, Web, FTL and the Docker image.
From `GET /api/info/version`.

| Path | Type | Description | Example |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `version.core.local.version` | `str` | Installed Pi-hole Core version (e.g. "v6.5") | `"v6.5"` |
| `version.web.local.version` | `str` | Installed Pi-hole Web version (e.g. "v6.5") | `"v6.6.1"` |
| `version.core.local.branch` | `str` | Git branch of the installed Pi-hole Core ("master" for releases) | `"master"` |
| `version.web.local.branch` | `str` | Git branch of the installed Pi-hole Web ("master" for releases) | `"master"` |
| `version.core.local.hash` | `str` | Git commit of the installed Pi-hole Core | `"f503a65d"` |
| `version.web.local.hash` | `str` | Git commit of the installed Pi-hole Web | `"fb699c4e"` |
| `version.core.remote.version` | `str` | Latest released Pi-hole Core version on GitHub (null if unknown, e.g. offline, or on custom branches) | `"v6.5"` |
| `version.web.remote.version` | `str` | Latest released Pi-hole Web version on GitHub (null if unknown, e.g. offline, or on custom branches) | `"v6.6.1"` |
| `version.core.remote.hash` | `str` | Git commit of the latest Pi-hole Core release (null if unknown, e.g. offline) | `"f503a65d"` |
| `version.web.remote.hash` | `str` | Git commit of the latest Pi-hole Web release (null if unknown, e.g. offline) | `"fb699c4e"` |
| `version.ftl.local.version` | `str` | Installed FTL version (e.g. "v6.8"; development builds report e.g. "vDev-eaa7dbb") | `"v6.7"` |
| `version.ftl.local.branch` | `str` | Git branch of the installed FTL ("master" for releases) | `"master"` |
| `version.ftl.local.hash` | `str` | Git commit of the installed FTL | `"6d1e4a93"` |
| `version.ftl.local.date` | `str` | Build time of the installed FTL (e.g. "2026-10-17 13:08:09 +0200") | `"2026-09-02 19:41:27 +0200"` |
| `version.ftl.remote.version` | `str` | Latest released FTL version on GitHub (null if unknown, e.g. offline, or on custom branches) | `"v6.8"` |
| `version.ftl.remote.hash` | `str` | Git commit of the latest FTL release (null if unknown, e.g. offline) | `"29c8b13f"` |
| `version.docker.local` | `str` | Docker image tag (e.g. "2026.10.0"); null when not running in Docker | `null` |
| `version.docker.remote` | `str` | Latest Docker image tag on Docker Hub; null if unknown or not running in Docker | `null` |
| `version.core.update` | `bool` | Whether a newer Core release is available (non-master branches: new commits); null if unknown, e.g. offline *(derived)* | `false` |
| `version.web.update` | `bool` | Whether a newer Web release is available (non-master branches: new commits); null if unknown, e.g. offline *(derived)* | `false` |
| `version.ftl.update` | `bool` | Whether a newer FTL release is available (non-master branches: new commits); null if unknown, e.g. offline *(derived)* | `true` |
| `version.docker.update` | `bool` | Whether a newer Docker image is available; null if unknown or not running in Docker *(derived)* | `null` |
| `updates.available` | `bool` | Whether an update is known to be available (in Docker only the image counts) *(derived)* | `true` |
| `updates.count` | `int` | Number of components known to have an update available *(derived)* | `1` |
| `updates.components` | `list[str]` | Components with an update available ("core", "web", "ftl", "docker") *(derived)* | `["ftl"]` |
| `updates.status` | `str` | "available" (an update is known to be available), "current" (no update known) or "unknown" (no update information yet, e.g. offline or rate-limited by GitHub) *(derived)* | `"available"` |
